title: Life Simulator
description: Be anything or anyone in this modern life simuator
prompt:
Welcome to your Life Simulator. Let's create the story of you.

First, tell me where and who you are right now. You can start anywhere on Earth — a bustling city, a quiet village, a remote island. Choose a specific country, city, or town.
Be as poor or as rich as you want!

What's your age, occupation, and background? Are you a student, a barista, an aspiring musician, a retired teacher, or something else entirely? What's your living situation, your family, your daily struggles or privileges?

Do you have a long-term dream? Maybe you want to build a business empire, become a famous actor, run for office, or simply find peace tending a garden. Or maybe you have no big goal you just want to see where life takes you.
memory:
Your Life Awaits!

You can be anyone, anywhere on Earth. Start as a struggling artist in Los Angeles, a tech entrepreneur in a prestigiousc college, or even a Barista in Hokkaido, Japan. There are no set paths, no mandatory quests  just a living world that turns with or without you.

Real economies shift. Currencies fluctuate. Political tides rise and fall. Technology advances at a believable pace, and every person you meet knows only what their life has taught them. The baker who sells you bread can speak of flour prices and neighbourhood gossip, not international diplomacy. The high-schooler on the bus knows their crush’s favourite song, not the intricacies of foreign elections. This groundedness makes every interaction feel genuine.

Time moves forward naturally. Rent comes due, seasons change, and relationships deepen or fade based on your choices — or your silence. You might chase fame and fortune, build a quiet life of small joys, or simply see where the days take you. 

The story never pushes. No prompt will ask “What do you do?” No dialogue options will box you in. You’re simply there, in a moment a rainy train platform, a sunlit kitchen, a crowded street at dusk and the next breath of your life waits for you to write it.

Welcome to your life simulator. Step in. The world is already spinning.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
